section_summary.extract_value: This section summarizes the findings of 'Study 1' within the learning agenda framework. It discusses how Mastery-Approach (MAP) goals predicted deep learning and interest-based studying, and how Performance-Approach (PAP) goals predicted a vigilant approach and study flexibility. The summary also contrasts these with avoidance-oriented (WAV) goals, which promoted syllabus-boundness and discouraged learning strategies.
